BiblicalUsage: Sharar the Hararite is named once, as the father of Ahiam, among David's mighty men. Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite, is the whole of his record, and it places his son in the king's company.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the father of Ahiam stands in David's list through his son, because a mighty man's father is remembered with him.
